approach.title: Discover
approach.text: Understand the business, audience, goals and requirements.

approach.title: Define
approach.text: Establish the direction, scope, structure and priorities.

approach.title: Design & Build
approach.text: Create the visual experience and, where appropriate, develop a functional application using suitable AI-assisted workflows.

approach.title: Refine & Deliver
approach.text: Test, improve and prepare the agreed deliverables.

reasons.title: Professional product design experience
reasons.text: Almost four years designing in-house at Max ERP / Meet Max in Dubai, from junior to product designer.

reasons.title: Design and branding in one person
reasons.text: Interface, identity and marketing materials that feel like the same brand.

reasons.title: Usability and visual clarity first
reasons.text: Layouts that make the next step obvious and the important things easy to find.

reasons.title: Dashboards and ERP interfaces
reasons.text: Experience designing ERP and dashboard interfaces around dense business data.

reasons.title: Modern AI tools, used carefully
reasons.text: Using AI-assisted development to move from idea to working prototype faster.

reasons.title: Collaborative, adaptable support
reasons.text: Works as a solo designer or alongside your team, at the pace the project needs.
